visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with short black hair wearing a white t-shirt stands in a modern kitchen with white cabinets and a stainless steel range hood. He holds a small pink silicone udder-shaped object close to the camera, pointing at it with his index finger while displaying an exaggerated, excited facial expression. Large white and red variety-show style captions appear over him. (2) He attaches the pink nozzle to a white plastic bottle filled with milk. He holds the bottle with both hands over a clear glass on the counter. He squeezes the pink protrusions, and white liquid streams out into the glass. The background remains the kitchen setting with domestic items like a sink and countertop visible. (3) The man drinks the milk from the glass, tilting his head back. A young woman with long dark hair and glasses enters the frame wearing a green tank top. They are seen laughing together in a medium shot. A large orange cat walks across the foreground on the kitchen counter while they interact. (4) In a new scene, the man holds a pink pig-shaped suction tool. He cracks a white egg onto a ceramic plate. He squeezes the pig and places its snout against the yellow yolk, which is then sucked inside the tool, separating it from the white. Close-up shots emphasize the separation of the egg components. (5) The man is lying on his stomach on a light-colored tile floor in a bedroom near a closed door. A black rolling alarm clock with white wheels beeps and rolls away from him. He crawls and reaches out his hand to catch it. The lighting is soft and domestic. (6) The man is back in the kitchen holding the gadgets. The view transitions to a screen recording of the Shopee app, showing a vertical video feed of products like jeans and plates. Red arrows and cursor icons point to specific UI elements like the video button and affiliate program link.
